verdict.rationale: Jan publishes no first-party SDK. Its documented local server is OpenAI-compatible at localhost:1337, and its /v1/messages endpoint explicitly supports "Anthropic SDK clients pointed at your local server." So developers can build with third-party vendor SDKs as a drop-in, but not against official Jan SDKs. Missing for 10: first-party Jan SDKs (any language), SDK docs and examples, an OpenAPI spec (probes 404), and an SDK versioning or stability policy.
